content.text:
I'd pick the second one. I'm fairly sure of that, but only because of one thing it adds. I don't think either of them is for me.

**What decided it:** In the second drawing, under each name in the "המדד" column, there's a sentence in plain Hebrew. "מאה עשרים וחמש החברות בעלות השווי הגבוה ביותר בבורסה בתל אביב." "חמש מאות החברות הגדולות בארצות הברית." Those I can read. In the first drawing it just says "ת"א-125", "S&P 500" and "MSCI AC World". To me a מדד is the price index on the news, so those told me nothing. The task was to see what each fund follows, and only the second one actually tells me.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **The heading "קרנות סל".** The heading is not deposits or savings. My first feeling was that this page isn't for me.
- **The grey line under it.** I think it said "רק הקרנות שהאתר אסף עליהן דוח…". I read it slowly and didn't quite follow it.
- **The fund names.** "אי.בי.אי. סל ת"א 125 (4A)". I don't know the company. I read the "4A" and "4D" letter by letter and they mean nothing to me.
- **The fees on the left.** Each fund has three numbers: "קבוע", "משתנה" and "נאמן". I don't add numbers up, so the first one stuck with me, 0.35% for the first fund. For the last two it says 0.8%, which looks like a lot next to the others. I can't tell what each fund costs in total. Are the three numbers added together? I don't know.
- **The second drawing.** It's the same table plus those sentences. Only the sentences were new to me.

**Words and signs I didn't understand:**
- On the little tags: "צוברת", "נאמן", "עסקת החלף", "מחזיקה את המניות", "חשיפה לדולר".
- "מס גם על שינויי המטבע". I stopped there. A tax, on what?
- "4A", "4D", "S&P", "MSCI AC World".
- "קבוע" and "משתנה". Fixed and variable what?

I didn't press the underlined numbers or the green "בדף הקרן במאיה". I didn't know what they'd open, and the words didn't say.

**What bothered me:**
- The whole screen is black with light letters. Even enlarged, it was hard on my eyes.
- The grey headings and the grey line at the top are faint.
- The green links and the green index names look almost the same colour to me.
- There are many numbers in every row, which made me anxious.
- Nothing here says whether any of this is as safe as a deposit. That's what I wanted to know, and it isn't here.

Two screens weren't too many, so I didn't get tired. But if this were a real page from my bank, I'd stop at the heading and ask you or the clerk.
